item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 06/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will weaken slightly over the weekend to early next week. There will be a few showers but still very hot over the coast of southern China. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea next Tuesday. A southwesterly airstream will affect southern China gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week, but it will remain very hot over inland areas.
